entries.title: Psalms 29:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David exhorts princes to give glory to God; 3 by reason of his power; 11 and protection of his people.

Give. 2:10-12; 68:31-34; 96:7-9; Isa 60:12; Jer 13:16-18; Re 5:11-14 mighty. Heb. sons of the mighty.

entries.title: Psalms 29:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Give. 1Ch 16:28,29 glory, etc. Heb. honour of his name. 96:6,8; 97:9; 113:3-6; 145:3-7 worship. 27:4; 96:9; 2Ch 20:21 the beauty of holiness. or, his glorious sanctuary. 90:17

entries.title: Psalms 29:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: powerful. Heb. in power. 33:9; Job 26:11-14; Jer 51:15,16; Lu 4:36; 8:25 full of. Heb. in. Job 40:9-12; Isa 66:6; Eze 10:5

entries.title: Psalms 29:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: skip. 114:4-7 Lebanon. Jer 4:23-25; Hab 3:6-11; Re 20:11 Sirion. De 3:9 unicorn. 92:10; Nu 23:22

entries.title: Psalms 29:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: divideth. Heb. cutteth out. flames. 77:18; 144:5,6; Ex 9:23; Le 10:2; Nu 16:35; 2Ki 1:10-12; Job 37:3 Job 38:35

entries.title: Psalms 29:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
maketh.Or as Bp. Lowth and others, "maketh the oaks to tremble and maketh bare the forests;" understanding {ayyaloth,} as denoting here, not hinds, but oaks, as it signifies in Syriac.

Job 39:1-3 calve. or, be in pain. discovereth. 63:2; Isa 9:18; 10:18,19; Eze 20:46-48 in his temple. 46:2-5; 48:9; 134:1,2; 135:1,2 doth, etc. or, every whit of it uttereth.
